text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Wishing you a very happy birthday today, 
Teio-san."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nishi-shi, thank you! Hey, hey, what do 
you think? Don't you think this one has 
become magnificent?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Who knows, this year I might catch up to 
the 'Emperor' before Zephyr does~♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my... A sudden, fleeting breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No matter how often the spring breeze 
blows, if one merely receives it 
passively, nothing is bound to change, is 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh~. Does that mean just getting older 
doesn't mean a thing?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I never said I wouldn't put in the effort! 
I'm just declaring that I'm gonna grow 
even more.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna keep acting so nonchalant, 
Zephyr, I really will leave you behind!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. We certainly can't let that 
happen, can we?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To reach the heights of the heavenly 
winds, convergence is essential. I, too, 
shall become the rumbling thunder.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sharpening each other's skills as rivals, 
huh? —Heheh, now that's what I'm talking 
about!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's see which of us catches up to the 
"Emperor" first. It's a race, Zephyr!
